task_description: Build 'The Page Is Lying', a Forge app for Confluence (Codegeist 2026, Apps for Software Teams, Rovo agent + rovo:mcp bonuses) that extracts checkable claims from runbook pages, checks them deterministically against a public GitHub repo, and marks each Verified / Contradicted by code / No evidence found with file:line evidence, plus a read-only Rovo agent, GET actions exposed via rovo:mcp, and an optional click-to-confirm Jira draft. Process step 1 (docs research + PLAN.md) is done; step 2 features below wait for the user's review of PLAN.md.
parallelism: FEAT-001 first. Then FEAT-002, FEAT-003, FEAT-005, FEAT-006, FEAT-007 in parallel; FEAT-004 can start in parallel on contracts but its golden test needs FEAT-002, FEAT-003 and FEAT-007.
